newsitem.title: JAPAN: JAPAN PC SHIPMENTS RISE 4 PCT YR/YR IN APRIL-JUNE.
newsitem.headline: JAPAN PC SHIPMENTS RISE 4 PCT YR/YR IN APRIL-JUNE.

text.p: Shipments of personal computers in Japan in the April-June period showed a rise of four percent from the same period last year to 1.7 million units, the Japan Electronic Industry Development Association said on Thursday.
In contrast, the PC shipments in the same period last year had shown a 51 percent increase year-on-year.

A spokesman for the industry organisation said demand for PCs waned in the quarter mainly because consumers had rushed to buy before the consumtion tax was raised to five percent from three percent on April 1.
Meanwhile, domestic shipments of portable computers, including sub-notebooks, in the April-June quarter rose 42 percent year-on-year to 684,000 units amid strong demand, the association said.
Total shipments of PCs by Japanese makers in the quarter totaled two million, down 8,000 from a year earlier.
Exports were down 21 percent to 291,000 units, reflecting a move by PC makers to shift production bases overseas.
